name: Flyer (Missing Dog)
description: A hand-drawn flyer for a missing dog named Comet, created by Maya and brought to the high school gym shelter during the emergency. The flyer is used to request a radio announcement about the missing dog.
narrative_significance: The flyer represents the human need to maintain personal connections and family bonds even during crisis. It serves as a bridge between the emergency broadcast system and individual stories, demonstrating how the community radio station expands its mission beyond critical infrastructure updates to include personal announcements. The successful recovery of Comet provides a moment of hope and levity that sustains the team's morale during the ongoing emergency response.
